items.title: Luther Henderson — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Baby Hines is another lady I worked with here in Washington when I was in the Navy here.

ctx.x: Bengasi maybe it was. Anyway, there was Viola Jefferson, that was her name. I looked of course and there was Ken who is Pissari(?) who is Fats, you know, and Andre de Shields who is Snake Hips Tucker. Most people never heard of Snake Hips Tucker. He was a male exotic dancer. Armelia who, you know, was like Baby Hines. Baby Hines is another lady I worked with here in Washington when I was in the Navy here. So I came into this place knowing the music and surprisingly enough, looking at these people who looked like…
Already a lot of interest generated.
